text: This step is only for those who did the udvasanam today.
Once the udvasanam is complete, carefully take the cloth, the blouse piece, the coconut and the mango leaves off the kalasham and keep them aside.
Take a little of the kalasham's water with the mango leaves and sprinkle it in the rooms of the house and around the house.
Pour the remaining water at the foot of a tree or a plant.
Keep the cloth offered to the Devi on the kalasham safely.
As your family's custom goes, you may tie that cloth at the doorway as a sign of the Devi's blessing.
You may also keep it in a safe place in your vehicle.
Keep the blouse piece separately and safely.
